studio-structure-polish · wave-2 visual addendum

The tiered desk, seen

live guerrilla · light + dark · stamped 2026-07-09

Pixel evidence for the studio-structure-polish epic: five states captured on the deployed product after waves 1–2 merged. Every screenshot is the real Studio over the real database — no mockups.

Default workspace — the clean desk

Papers, Sheets, Tasks and Projects in MAIN; …Rest at the bottom; no plugin noise. This is what a fresh workspace looks like now.

Vizcheck — OnixEdit promoted, Tickets under Plugins

OnixEdit (enabled + promoted to MAIN) contributes Books and the Bokbasen section top-level, plus its Bokbasen top-menu tab; Tickets (enabled, default placement) nests inside the drilled Plugins tier.

Vizcheck — …Rest tells the truth

Ad-hoc types with no plugin home land in …Rest with honest per-type counts — organized, never silently hidden.

Workspace Settings

Theme picker + per-plugin enable/disable and placement promotion, with off-by-default badges.

Styleguide theme matrix

Every theme × mode swatch auto-fits its iframe — the per-cell scrollbars are gone.

Findings from the pass
(1) Workspace Settings binds its workspace at mount and does NOT follow the scope switcher — writes can land on the wrong workspace (filed ssp-w3-settings-scope-bind, priority 1). (2) Enabling a plugin whose schema types don't exist in the workspace gives no visible tree change (correct per the never-render-empty rule, but zero feedback — wave-3 UX candidate).
